description: Complete inventory of all CreatorOS source truth surfaces: Google Docs, GitHub main, Beast clone, UMH projection code, prior phase artifacts, operator corrections, VPS schema copy, and design references.

google_docs.title: CreatorOS
google_docs.content_summary: PRD v2.90. Comprehensive product requirements document defining 16 modules, 28 screens, workflows, AI concepts, business model, pricing tiers, data concepts, and acceptance criteria. Contains 3 conflicting MVP scope definitions, 3 conflicting auth provider recommendations, 2 conflicting backend framework references, and 3 conflicting timeline definitions.
google_docs.notes: Operator-authored product vision document. Primary source of desired state claims. Read via GWS API in Phase 14.3A. Tab 1 is the main PRD, Tab 8 contains supplementary material. Unlike the EOS doc (10 tabs, 2.09M chars), CreatorOS is a more focused single-product PRD.

google_docs.notes: Not CreatorOS-specific but defines the platform contract CreatorOS must satisfy as a UMH projection.

god_files.issue: All 89 API routes in single monolithic file. Must be split before parallel development is possible.
All data access/storage logic in single file. Every table's CRUD operations in one file. Tightly coupled to Drizzle ORM with no abstraction layer.

github_main.tests: ZERO -- no test files exist in the repository
github_main.deployment_config: NONE -- no Dockerfile, no Fly.io config, no CI/CD

beast.auth: Passport.js (same broken code as GitHub main)
beast.vps_note: Beast clone lives on Windows machine at C:\dev\dev\CreatorOS. Same main branch, same commits as GitHub. No divergent feature branch exists (unlike EOS which has a 603-file feature/company-system branch). Analysis uses GitHub main as single code source.
beast.file_count_difference_note: 271 files on Beast vs 296 on GitHub. Difference is likely .gitignored files or attached_assets not present locally. No code divergence -- same commits, same branch.
beast.key_difference_from_eos: CreatorOS has NO feature branch divergence. GitHub main IS the single source of code truth. EOS has a 603-file Beast branch that is the canonical promotion candidate. This makes CreatorOS source topology simpler: one codebase to analyze, not two.

operator_corrections.content: CreatorOS is owned by Empyrean Studio, not Lyfe Institute. Empyrean Studio is the entity that owns all creative/media products.
operator_corrections.impact: Corrects ownership attribution. Empyrean Studio, not Lyfe Institute, is the parent entity.

operator_corrections.content: CreatorOS is a creator-economy operating system -- 'Whop on steroids.' NOT a 'content management tool' or 'creator platform.' It is the command center for modern creators.
operator_corrections.impact: Elevates product positioning from tool/platform to operating system. Center of gravity is creator economic activity.

operator_corrections.content: Product promise: 'Post once, publish everywhere. Host everything, sell to everyone.'
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical one-line product promise. Captures both distribution (post/publish) and commerce (host/sell) value propositions.

operator_corrections.content: Design identity: X/Twitter-inspired minimalism, NOT glassmorphism. Clean, fast, functional. Mobile-first social platform aesthetic.
operator_corrections.impact: Constrains all UI/UX decisions. Kills any glassmorphism or RPG aesthetic that may appear in prior docs or references.

operator_corrections.content: 16 modules catalogued: Content Distribution, Community Hub, Course Platform, Marketplace, Consumer Feed, Dashboard, Editing Studio, UGC Campaigns, Ads Platform, Cross-Posting, Automation Builder, Email/Newsletter, Stories, Notifications, Moderation, Roles & Permissions.
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical module list. Confirms 16 modules align with desired state canon.

operator_corrections.content: 28 screens catalogued from desired state. 16 pages implemented in current code.
operator_corrections.impact: 12-screen gap between desired (28) and implemented (16). Gap analysis needed per screen.

operator_corrections.content: 10 product types: community, ai_agent, digital_download, course, subscription_membership, service, event, physical_product, ugc_campaign, software_access.
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical product type list. Commerce architecture must support all 10 types.

operator_corrections.content: Primitive hierarchy: User -> CreatorAccount -> Business -> Product -> Order -> Entitlement.
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical data ontology primitive chain. Different from EOS hierarchy (Operator -> Portfolio -> Entity -> Operations -> Teams -> Workflows -> Capital).

operator_corrections.content: Passport.js auth is BROKEN (comparePasswords returns true for ALL). P0 security vulnerability. Target auth: Clerk.
operator_corrections.impact: Confirms auth bypass is P0 blocker. Cannot ship anything user-facing. Migration target is Clerk (same as EOS Beast branch).

operator_corrections.content: God files: routes.ts (53KB) and storage.ts (104KB) must be split before parallel development.
operator_corrections.impact: Confirms god files as P1 blocker for development velocity. Must split before any significant feature work.

operator_corrections.content: 4-tier pricing: Free/Starter (Free, 3 platforms, 1 community, 1 course, 8% fee), Pro ($29/mo, unlimited, 5% fee), Business ($79/mo, team seats, API, white-label, 3% fee), Enterprise ($199+/mo, custom).
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical pricing structure. Revenue model combines subscription + transaction fees.

operator_corrections.content: EOS boundary: EOS handles business operations (portfolio, entity, org chart, financial tracking, AI agent hierarchy). CreatorOS handles creator product/distribution/community (content, publishing, audience, commerce, marketplace, courses, UGC, ads). Shared via UMH: identity, permissions, AI runtime, workflow engine, event bus, memory graph.
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical boundary definition. CreatorOS and EOS are separate products with separate databases, separate deployments, but shared UMH platform kernel.

operator_corrections.content: No tests exist. No production deployment. No UMH integration active. 90 design reference files exist (Stitch UI inventory needed).
operator_corrections.impact: Confirms zero test coverage, zero deployment infrastructure, zero runtime UMH integration. Design references need cataloguing.

operator_corrections.content: Target users: Creators (3 tiers: Emerging 1K-50K, Established 50K-500K, Creator Businesses 500K+), Consumers (Superfans, Learners, Community Members), UGC Creators, Advertisers.
operator_corrections.impact: Canonical user segmentation. Creator tiers define feature gating and pricing strategy.
